## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Changes are limited to the approved issue.
- [ ] Dependencies are merged; no competing implementation PR is open.
- [ ] Behavior and failures are accurately represented.
- [ ] Documentation or spike results are updated when needed.

> Do not merge automatically. Owner reviews the PR and decides when the next task starts.
